findings.title: 3 of 20 jobs miss their deadline
findings.detail: Worst lateness 1000 us; affected threads: event_handler (3). Worst-case response time 2400 us.
findings.recommendation: Run `chronoscope fix` to derive a counterfactually verified priority/inheritance/partition configuration, then re-audit.
findings.qnx_reference: System Architecture > What is Real Time and Why Do I Need It?

findings.title: SCHED_SPORADIC budget exhausted 3 time(s)
findings.detail: The thread dropped to its low priority until replenishment, which can turn a bounded response into a missed deadline.
findings.recommendation: Increase initial budget or reduce replenishment period.

findings.title: latency_spike on event_handler (job #3, 700.0 us)
findings.detail: robust z=750.00 (median=400.0us, MAD-sigma=0.400us); response time is 1.8x baseline
findings.recommendation: Compare with a traceprinter dump from the QNX 8.0 target using `chronoscope reconcile`.
findings.qnx_reference: System Analysis Toolkit User's Guide > Events and the Kernel

timing_evidence.purpose: Structured timing evidence for an ISO 26262 / IEC 62304 / DO-178C style safety case. This is engineering evidence, NOT a certification artifact or a claim of compliance.
timing_evidence.scheduling_model: QNX Neutrino: 256 priority levels, message-driven priority inheritance, SCHED_FIFO/RR/SPORADIC, adaptive partitioning
timing_evidence.reproducibility: Deterministic discrete-event replay; re-run `chronoscope simulate MODEL` to reproduce exactly.
